name: Course Completion Certificate
html:
{{ oc_reissue_mark(doc) }}

{{ doc.company }}

{{ _("Course Completion Certificate") }}

{{ _("No.") }} {{ doc.certificate_number }}
{{ _("Date") }}: {{ frappe.format(doc.issued_on, {"fieldtype": "Date"}) if doc.issued_on else "" }}

{% set dob = frappe.db.get_value("Student", doc.student, "date_of_birth") %}

{{ _("This is to certify that") }} {{ doc.student_name }} ({{ doc.student }}){% if dob %}, {{ _("born on") }} {{ frappe.format(dob, {"fieldtype": "Date"}) }},{% endif %} {{ _("has successfully completed the course of study at this institution.") }}

{{ _("This certificate is issued for the purpose of") }}: {{ doc.purpose }}.

{{ _("Principal") }}

{{ oc_qr_block(doc) }}
